Deepest plausible sample depth in the CalCOFI region, metres

Source: R/depth.R
CC_DEPTH_MAX_M.Rd

The abyssal plain under the westernmost historical stations (~158°W) is ~5,500 m and the region has no trench; 6,500 m matches the ceiling already declared on pressure (6,500 dbar). A depth beyond it is an error, not an observation.

Usage

CC_DEPTH_MAX_M

Format

An object of class numeric of length 1.
